description.en: Sets a global engine "internal flag" (a numbered system-wide switch, e.g. IFLAG_WAZA_EVENT, IFLAG_BUILD_FINISH, IFLAG_END_AUTO_FADEIN_OFF) to the given value. These flags are read back with CMND_GET_SYS_IFLAG and are used by scripts to coordinate state with the engine (e.g. temporarily disabling auto fade-in, or signalling that a technique/skill event is running).
The IFLAG_* constant identifying the flag to change.
The value to store for that flag (commonly 0 or 1).
